issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְקֹדְרִים שָׂגְבוּ יֶשַׁע' means 'and those who mourn are raised to safety/victory' (literally 'mourners are exalted [with] salvation'), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'and cause those who are sad to be comforted' (khiến những kẻ buồn rầu được an ủi), which changes the meaning from exaltation/salvation to comfort, and adds the causative 'khiến' not present in the Hebrew.
